$comment: Machine-readable mirror of app/globals.css. Consumed by the Remotion video project and any other target that needs the same brand. Keep in sync with globals.css — that file is the source of truth for the web.
$rebrand: August 2026: 'The Record' (Court Navy) replaced the previous blue/gold identity. Video assets already rendered still carry the OLD civic-blue and gold palette and the old Source Serif 4 / Inter type stack until they are re-rendered against these tokens. Treat any existing MP4 as stale, not as a second source of truth.
name: eNotarizationPH

identity.$comment: Bone paper, midnight-navy ink, antique brass. Editorial broadsheet: squared corners, rules not shadows. The site presents as a public record of a legal change, not as a product.
identity.mark: The Seal — concentric rings, a milled outer edge of 48 teeth, and a ruled centre. Pure SVG on a 100x100 viewBox; see components/marks/Seal.tsx.

paper.$comment: Warm neutral. The page is bone, never white.

navy.$comment: Ink and structure. 800 is INK, 900 is the seal navy / night background.

brass.$comment: The accent. 300 is the accent ON NAVY; 700 is the only brass safe for text on paper. Nothing between them may carry text on a light surface.

civic.$comment: Links only — the one flag cue retained. Deliberately just two stops: 600 on paper, 300 on navy.

semantic.$comment: Deliberately unclaimed by the brand. Night variants differ; both editions are asserted by scripts/check-contrast.mjs.

contrast.$comment: Verified ratios the palette depends on. Every pair is asserted by scripts/check-contrast.mjs (49 pairs, both editions) — run `npm run check:contrast`. Do not introduce a foreground/background pair here without adding its assertion there.
contrast.note: brass-300 through brass-500 are accent and surface colours only; on a light background the ONLY brass that may carry text is brass-700. On navy, brass-300 is the accent and clears 10.07:1.

type.$comment: Four families, each with one job. Display is Instrument Serif at WEIGHT 400 ONLY — the family ships nothing heavier, and asking for 600/700 makes the renderer synthesise a fake bold that smears its high-contrast strokes. Size carries emphasis, never weight.

display.role: headings, the OG card title, the masthead

ui.role: nav, buttons, labels, form controls, tables

data.role: datelines, ledger numerals, dates, amounts, statuses

tracking.$comment: Size-specific, never one fixed value. Display tracks NEGATIVE and small text tracks POSITIVE.

radius.$comment: Square by design — a record has edges. Cards, buttons, inputs, callouts and banners are all 0. Deliberately NOT squared: status chips and the seal, because a pill reads as a label and a circle reads as a mark.

rule.$comment: Structure comes from rules and space, not from lift. The brass rule marks every section head and dateline; the hairline divides content.

elevation.$comment: A record sits on paper; it does not float. Shadows are almost absent by design.

motion.$comment: Critically damped is the house default; bounce only after a real gesture (Apple: damping / response). Every animation is additive — the page is complete and readable with all of it switched off.

signatures.sealDraw: The seal strokes itself on, once, over `draw`. Outer ring circumference is 238.8 (2*pi*38) — seed the dash offset with the exact figure, not a rounded one.
